mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 75 degrees and an air quality index of 54.

The City of Verona works with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, with updates presented to the City Council at each meeting. Also, keep in mind the Senior Center offers a wonderful free tri-shaw bike program on the Military Ridge State Trail for those looking to enjoy the scenery.
There is plenty to do, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow, and hockey opportunities starting August 9.
On July 31, police stopped a driver for equipment violations and arrested them for O W I and related charges.

Today's flavor is the delicious Really Reese's. You can also catch Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4 PM. If you miss out, the store opens tomorrow at 10 AM featuring the Andes Mint Avalanche.
